user.title: Set up Ghost Mode
user.description: Ghost Mode learns how your home looks while it is occupied and replays that pattern while you are away, so an empty house still looks lived-in. Submit to add it — it finds your lights, switches, covers and media players on its own.

abort.already_configured: Ghost Mode is already set up.

learn_now.name: Learn now
learn_now.description: Read recorder history into the learned profile straight away, instead of waiting for the nightly run.
